defaultSession.title: New Conversation
defaultSession.welcome:
**Welcome, Officer!**

I am the **TLBM AI Assistant** — an intelligent semantic Q&A and document retrieval system for administrative procedures.

I prioritize searching our digitized knowledge base (PDF, DOCX, TXT), analyzing incoming/outgoing records, and deep linking with operational modules. Choose a suggested topic below or ask any question!
defaultSession.quickPrompt2: How are documents classified and access controlled?
defaultSession.quickPrompt3: How does internal Ed25519 signing with OTP work?

incoming.title: Incoming Documents
incoming.desc: Learn how to register incoming documents and send them for handling.
incoming.query: What is the standard procedure for receiving and processing incoming documents?

confidential.title: Internal document access rules
confidential.desc: Learn how access is controlled for internal documents and knowledge base materials.
confidential.query: How does the system control access to internal documents?

signing.title: Internal signing
signing.desc: Internal Ed25519 signing with a signing key, PIN, and two-factor OTP.
signing.query: How does internal Ed25519 signing with a signing key, PIN, and OTP work?

organization.title: Organization & Permissions
organization.desc: Lookup level 1 & 2 department hierarchy and employee permission matrix.
organization.query: How does the staff permission and role management system work?
